clock_waveform.TCK_role: Test Clock. Generated by the tester. Free-running while a scan is in progress; may be stopped or stretched between scans (the FSM holds its current stable state when TCK stops).
clock_waveform.rising_edge: TMS and TDI are sampled here. TAP FSM transitions on this edge. Capture / shift-update of IR and selected DR happen on this edge.
clock_waveform.falling_edge: TDO is updated here so that the next device in the daisy chain sees a stable TDI on the following rising edge of TCK.
clock_waveform.frequency_range: Typical 10-50 MHz at the chip level; lower (1-10 MHz) over backplanes and long board chains. Implementation-defined per device.

tms_tdi_tdo_waveform.TMS_role: Drives FSM transitions; latched on rising edge of TCK.
tms_tdi_tdo_waveform.TDI_role: Shift-in data for IR (in ShiftIR) or selected DR (in ShiftDR); latched on rising edge of TCK; LSB first.
tms_tdi_tdo_waveform.TDO_role: Shift-out data for IR (in ShiftIR) or selected DR (in ShiftDR); driven on falling edge of TCK; LSB first.
tms_tdi_tdo_waveform.TDO_3state_rule: TDO is in the high-impedance state in all FSM states except ShiftIR and ShiftDR. This lets multiple devices' TDOs be combined externally without contention (although daisy-chain usage avoids this entirely).

reset_waveform.TMS_reset_sequence: TMS=1 for 5 consecutive TCK rising edges from any state forces TestLogicReset.
reset_waveform.TRST_asynchronous_reset: TRST=LOW (when implemented) forces the TAP FSM to TestLogicReset immediately, independent of TCK.

ir_scan_waveform_summary: TMS=0 → CaptureIR (1 TCK): IR parallel-loaded with b...b01 pattern.
TMS=0 (N times) → ShiftIR: shift N-bit IR LSB first via TDI; previous IR contents emerge LSB-first on TDO (falling edges).
TMS=1 → UpdateIR (1 TCK): new IR contents become the current instruction on the falling edge.
TMS=0 → RunTestIdle (or TMS=1 → SelectDRScan to start a DR scan immediately).
dr_scan_waveform_summary: TMS=0 → CaptureDR (1 TCK): selected DR parallel-loaded with its capture value (BSR captures pins; Bypass captures 0; IDCODE captures hard-wired ID; user DRs per definition).
TMS=0 (M times) → ShiftDR: shift M-bit DR LSB first via TDI; previous DR contents emerge LSB-first on TDO.
TMS=1 → UpdateDR (1 TCK): shifted DR is parallel-latched (e.g. EXTEST drive values reach output pins on the falling edge of TCK).

rows: Implementation-defined; typical 20-100 ns at chip level.
TDO output delay from TCK fall
timing_parameters_per_device.notes: IEEE 1149.1 does not specify absolute values; per-device datasheets do. Across-chain skew is limited by the slowest device + board interconnect; testers typically run TCK well below each device's worst-case maximum.

voltage_levels.modulation: NRZ (two-level); eye opened by transmitter four-phase EQ + receiver CTLE/DFE.
voltage_levels.lane_margining: Receiver eye margin measured in-system via time (left/right) and optional voltage (up/down) margining.

hs_entry_waveform.step_1_stop: LP-11 on both Dp and Dn (idle Stop state).
hs_entry_waveform.step_2_request: LP-01 (Dp LOW, Dn HIGH) for T-LPX (~50 ns min).
hs_entry_waveform.step_3_bridge: LP-00 (both LOW) for T-LPX (~50 ns min).
hs_entry_waveform.step_4_prepare: HS driver switches on; drive HS-0 (differential zero) for T-HS-PREPARE (40+4UI .. 85+6UI ns).
hs_entry_waveform.step_5_zero: Continue HS-0 for T-HS-ZERO (≥ 105 + 6 × UI ns) — receiver locks HS clock-data alignment.
hs_entry_waveform.step_6_sync: Transmit 8-bit Sync pattern 8'b00011101 (LSB-first on the wire = 10111000).
hs_entry_waveform.step_7_payload: Stream CSI-2 packet bytes at full HS rate; byte 0 → lane 0, byte 1 → lane 1, ...
hs_entry_waveform.step_8_trail: Hold last bit for T-HS-TRAIL (max(8UI, 60+4UI) ns).
hs_entry_waveform.step_9_exit: Disable HS driver; LP driver forces LP-11 (Stop). T-HS-EXIT ≥ 100 ns of LP-11 before next transaction.

escape_entry_waveform.step_2_request: LP-10 (Dp HIGH, Dn LOW) for T-LPX.
escape_entry_waveform.step_4_escape_pattern: Transmit escape pattern (ULPS / Trigger / Reset code) at LP rate (≤ 10 Mbps).

payload_byte_serialization.format: Each byte transmitted LSB-first on the wire (bit 0 first, bit 7 last).
payload_byte_serialization.ecc_byte_order: Single ECC byte covers DI + WC[7:0] + WC[15:8].
payload_byte_serialization.crc_byte_order: CRC-16 footer: CRC[7:0] first, then CRC[15:8] (little-endian on the wire over bytes; but computed MSB-first over payload).
payload_byte_serialization.multilane_interleave: With N lanes: byte k → lane (k mod N), byte k+N → lane (k mod N), ...; sync byte is replicated on every active lane.

data_signaling_waveforms.HS_0: differential 0 (CLK_P - CLK_N < 0, i.e. Dn HIGH, Dp LOW)
data_signaling_waveforms.HS_1: differential 1 (CLK_P - CLK_N > 0, i.e. Dp HIGH, Dn LOW)
data_signaling_waveforms.LP_11: Stop state — both Dp and Dn at 1.2 V (CMOS HIGH)
data_signaling_waveforms.LP_01: HS Request — Dp LOW, Dn HIGH
data_signaling_waveforms.LP_10: Escape Request — Dp HIGH, Dn LOW

general_timing_rule: PCI Express 5.0 is character-timed at a 31.25 ps Unit Interval per Lane (32 GT/s, NRZ). Higher-level state machines (LTSSM sub-states, Recovery.Equalization, FC init, Replay) are specified in Symbol/Block Times so they scale across generations.

packet_framing_waveform.tlp_framing: STP (K27.7) → 12-bit Sequence Number → TLP header (3 or 4 DW) → optional data payload → 16-bit LCRC → END (K29.7), or EDB (K30.7) for nullified TLP.
packet_framing_waveform.dllp_framing: SDP (K28.2) → DLLP type byte + DLLP-specific fields → 16-bit CRC → END (K29.7).
packet_framing_waveform.lane_placement: STP / SDP MUST be placed on Lane 0 when the Link is wider than x1.
packet_framing_waveform.logical_idle: When no TLP / DLLP / ordered-set is being transmitted, IDL data character (00h) is sent on all Lanes, scrambled and 8b/10b-encoded.

TS1.purpose: Polling / Configuration / Equalization training; carries Link Number, Lane Number, N_FTS, the Data Rate Identifier (incl. 32.0 GT/s bit), EQ presets/coefficients, and Alternate Protocol Negotiation fields.

TS2.purpose: Final-handshake training set confirming Lane/Link and rate/EQ agreement before sustaining the trained rate.

SKP.purpose: Skip ordered set; clock-tolerance compensation (±300 ppm) and carrier for Lane Margining control.

FTS.purpose: Fast Training Sequence — exit L0s to L0.

EIOS.purpose: Electrical Idle Ordered Set before TX enters Electrical Idle.

EIEOS.purpose: Electrical Idle Exit Ordered Set — re-acquire block lock on exit.

ltssm_transition_trigger_waveform.Polling_to_Configuration: Sufficient consecutive TS1/TS2 ordered sets with valid Lane/Link numbers observed.
ltssm_transition_trigger_waveform.Configuration_to_L0: Lane width + Lane number agreement complete; initial L0 at 2.5 GT/s for backward compatibility.
ltssm_transition_trigger_waveform.L0_to_Recovery_for_speed_change: Either end initiates a data-rate change; TS1/TS2 advertise the target rate via the Data Rate Identifier.
ltssm_transition_trigger_waveform.Recovery_Equalization_at_32GTs: If both ends advertise 32.0 GT/s, Recovery runs the Phase 0-3 enhanced equalization (with preset hints and retimers) before settling at 32 GT/s.
ltssm_transition_trigger_waveform.L0_to_L0s: TX sends EIOS then enters Electrical Idle (per direction).
ltssm_transition_trigger_waveform.L0_to_L1: Both ends agree via PM DLLPs; transitions through Recovery.

clock_tolerance_compensation.purpose: SKP ordered sets let the receive elastic buffer absorb/generate symbols to compensate up to ±300 ppm clock-rate mismatch; at Gen5 SKP also carries Lane Margining control.

transmitter_eye_diagram_reference: Figure 4-32 — Minimum Transmitter Timing and Voltage Output Compliance Specification.
receiver_eye_diagram_reference: Figure 4-34 — Minimum Receiver Eye Timing and Voltage Compliance Specification.

line_rate_waveform.encoding: 128b/130b — 128 payload bits + 2-bit sync header per 130-bit block; ~1.54% overhead.

block_framing_waveform.block_layout: 2-bit sync header (10b = Data Block, 01b = Ordered Set Block) + 128-bit scrambled payload, per lane.
block_framing_waveform.tlp_framing: TLP bytes carried inside Data Blocks; framing tokens are byte values, not 8b/10b K-codes.
block_framing_waveform.lane_placement: First byte of any TLP/DLLP on Lane 0 when wider than x1.

equalization_waveform.description: At 32 GT/s the link runs Recovery.Equalization through four phases, exchanging transmitter coefficient/preset requests between partners and through any retimers, until the eye is open.
